title: The compatible-real homogeneous slice is an exact current-free invariant manifold

invariant_manifold.real_structure: Fix a conjugation C with C^2=I and CQ=QC; let H_R=Fix(C). This is a repository control, not a source-selected reality condition.
invariant_manifold.data: On normalized T3 take A=E=0 and phi(t,x)=u(t), pi(t,x)=v(t) with u,v in H_R and the required Q graph domains.
invariant_manifold.spatial_current: All spatial covariant derivatives vanish, so j^a=e Im<Q u,D^a u>=0.
invariant_manifold.charge_density: The inner product of C-real vectors is real, so rho=e Im<Q u,v>=0.
invariant_manifold.invariance: The Maxwell equations preserve A=E=0 and the reduced vector field commutes with C, so the homogeneous real slice is invariant.
invariant_manifold.spectral_scope: The manifold permits arbitrary finite or infinite Q-spectral support subject to the declared graph domain.
invariant_manifold.boundary: This is not a gauge fixing of every solution and carries no nonzero spatial Fourier mode or Maxwell radiation.
